label: BL
reason: User-supplied header names flow directly into fileName which is used in FileOutputStream and HTML-encoded for display. However, ESAPI.encodeForHTML only encodes characters relevant to HTML context, whereas path traversal requires encoding slashes (/), which remain unencoded. Reviewers may dispute whether this constitutes a genuine path traversal risk (TP) or if the lack of slash encoding makes it benign (FP).

evidence.note: Header names extracted via getHeaderNames() and assigned to param, then used in fileName for FileOutputStream and printed with encodeForHTML which does not sanitize slashes
